configurable_props.name: name
configurable_props.label: Version Name
configurable_props.description: The unique name of the version. The maximum length is 255 characters.

configurable_props.name: archived
configurable_props.label: Archived
configurable_props.description: Indicates that the version is archived

configurable_props.name: startDate
configurable_props.label: Start Date
configurable_props.description: The start date of the version. Expressed in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-mm-dd).

configurable_props.name: releaseDate
configurable_props.label: Release Date
configurable_props.description: The release date of the version. Expressed in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-mm-dd).

configurable_props.name: expand
configurable_props.label: Expand
configurable_props.description:
Use expand to include additional information about the version in the response. This parameter accepts a comma-separated list. Expand options include:
`operations` Returns the list of operations available for this version.
`issuesstatus` Returns the count of issues in this version for each of the status categories `to do`, `in progress`, `done`, and `unmapped`.
